name: Illusion Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Silent Image; Phantasmal Force; Major Image; Hallucinatory Terrain; Seeming. Reference-only: Slotted Illusions require only costly or consumed Material components. Investigation checks to discern your spell illusions have Disadvantage.
